summary: A scheduled retry with the same source file, data fingerprint and effective guardrails should not create a second history record.
reproduction: Append the same report, source label and data fingerprint twice within five seconds.
observed_before: Two history records were stored for one unchanged analysis input.
release_result: The first write returns stored; an identical retry returns duplicate_skipped and preserves one record, while changed guardrails produce a distinct analysis-context fingerprint and record.
adoption_claim: Synthetic regression case only; not real operator feedback or production adoption.
